entries.claim: Historical English basis of the Communion (John 13:12, 13 and 15 through this missal), revised against the Latin in contemporary language: Do you know what I have done to you, I, the Lord and Master? (Scitis quid fécerim vobis ego, Dóminus et Magíster?), that you also may do likewise (ut et vos ita faciátis). Additional revision: postquam cenavit (w003–w004) is after He had eaten supper. The bare Lord/Master apposition is an optional modern revision of the retained possessive wording, not a finding that the historical your is false.
